criteria.requirement: Add babel.numbers.parse_currency(string, currency, locale=None, *, strict=True, numbering_system="latn") returning Decimal. Currency is mandatory and validated; support the pinned locale standard/accounting positive and negative affixes with either its actual symbol or ISO code, and its grouping/decimal/numbering symbols. Reject wrong currency, missing currency markers, trailing junk, embedded signs, unbalanced parentheses and nonfinite amounts. Strict mode requires canonical format_currency rendering at currency precision. Do not guess currencies from ambiguous symbols, silently remove interior characters or modify parse_decimal.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
